scope: Paired original native interactive-window preview for modeled Macintosh 128K/68000 and PC/AT 286. System software remains unreleased.

owner_authorization.instruction: Just finish the release without me. Do it now, and don't stop until you are done.
owner_authorization.disposition: Complete automated qualification and publish this bounded experimental pair without further human testing. This supersedes the prior separate-publication and further-human-test prerequisites for this preview only; it does not mark those tests passed.

acceptance.E1: Existing scoped host tests and independent pixel oracles pass; not complete historical or System acceptance.
acceptance.E2: 46 input-profile checks include 44 loss-free axis/diagonal cases, a loss-free owner-trace replay at 4096 and a required 27-omission negative control at 2048. Exact media passes 16 install/failure checks, eight native states and eight paired pixel/replay checkpoints.
acceptance.E3: Prior live Mac input was delivered and recorded. No new host-input qualification is claimed by headless checks.
acceptance.E4: M1R5 failed the owner's relative-speed/axis expectations. M1R6b was an idle boot with zero input. 286 human testing remains incomplete. Owner directs release without further human testing.
acceptance.physical: Unverified; all current target qualification uses BootHush.
acceptance.provenance: Author source/rights review and repository guards; independent human provenance/toolchain review remains pending.

limitations: Experimental preview, not a complete operating system or general Macintosh application compatibility release.
Mac 2048-cycle mouse edge spacing loses intermediate movements in the retained trace and is unsupported for this release. Use the stated 4096-cycle profile.
Host pointer gain, perceived relative speed and axis latency remain unqualified. Automated replay is not a human mouse-feel pass.
PC preview uses keyboard arrows and held Space for pointer/button input; it is not a PC mouse driver.
286 installer supports only a blank whole disk in the stated 615/4/17 model; physical BIOS/storage compatibility is unverified.
Historical edition identity, physical/full128K, B2, System1 interoperability in both directions, native external applications, Linux and independent provenance review remain open.
The separate Not Super Tilt Bro prototype is incomplete; optional port media is evidence, not a delivered game release.
BootHush/compiler/FFmpeg binaries and reference firmware are not included. The exact tested emulator is identified by hash.
